scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke Stralsund charging-tariff page explicitly publishes anonymous AdHoc charging without registration by QR code: EUR 0.52/kWh AC up to 22 kW and EUR 0.62/kWh DC up to 210 kW, no monthly fee, plus EUR 0.10/min blocking fee from 120 minutes after charging ends. AC connectors at the Bergen/Toom fast-charging locations are billed at the DC price. Roaming remains separate.

tariff.special_case: AC connectors at Bergen/Toom fast chargers billed at DC price

this_pass.evidence: Multiple current station-level public records consistently expose anonymous direct payment at sampled Stadtwerke Greifswald AC EVSEs at EUR 0.50/kWh plus EUR 0.10/min after 240 minutes. The evidence is station-level and current, but no first-party operator-wide 2026 tariff matrix was located, so sampled values are not generalized to the complete CPO network.
this_pass.reason: exact direct-payment prices are verified on multiple sampled EVSEs, but operator-wide tariff scope is not established first-party

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke SH material confirms own public charging infrastructure and an E-Mobilitätskarte discount. The Parkhaus am Noor page states card charging there at EUR 0.45/kWh versus EUR 0.50/kWh at the operator's other charging stations. Independent current station-level records show direct/ad-hoc prices can differ by location and power class, including EUR 0.57/kWh and EUR 0.77/kWh, therefore the card/site figure is not promoted to a universal ad-hoc tariff.
this_pass.reason: official prices found are card/site-specific while current direct-payment station prices vary; no universal operator-wide ad-hoc matrix proven

this_pass.evidence: Stadtwerke Husum officially documents its public fast-charging infrastructure. Current station-level direct-payment data for operator EVSE DE*HUS*EHU086*01/*02 expose EUR 0.74/kWh and EUR 0.10/min after 240 minutes. No current first-party operator-wide AC/DC direct-payment matrix was located, so the sampled DC value is retained only as station-level evidence.
this_pass.reason: exact sampled DC EVSE tariff available, but first-party network-wide direct-payment tariff scope remains unproven

this_pass.evidence: Current first-party neu.sw surfaces confirm electromobility products but the indexed current material is focused on private wallboxes and household energy products. No authoritative 2026 public-charging ad-hoc price matrix or public QR checkout tariff was established during this pass.
this_pass.reason: public CPO tariff could not be verified from an authoritative current first-party or station-level checkout surface

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke Wismar material confirms an electromobility section and multiple charging-hardware types in its network, but the indexed 2026 first-party pages do not expose an authoritative public direct-payment price matrix. Household product WismarStromMobil is not treated as public charging and is not promoted to ad-hoc.
this_pass.reason: public direct-payment tariff is not exposed in current first-party indexed material; household electricity prices are out of scope
